# A way of units: a turn with no mark given

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-way-of-units` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-way-of-units.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A way is the units present, each going on while the level meets its need and taking its use. Under the regime's premises along the course, its line never ends exactly where it comes to a way that is not empty, whose units' needs are all met at a level from which what they take together holds.

<a id="exact-statement--确切陈述"></a>
## Exact statement

A way is the units present; each unit goes on while the level meets its own need and takes its own use from the level. Under the regime's premises along the course, the line never ends exactly where it comes to a way that is not empty, whose units' needs are all met, at a level from which what they take together holds. For two units, the first needing at least as much, this is the exact condition for turning in time with its premises on marks proved; a greater need of the first unit, or more of the use on it, never ends a line that did not end; and with a first unit that takes nothing the line never ends exactly where the second unit's line alone never ends.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A unit u is a pair of whole numbers, need u and use u; a way is a list of units. A unit goes on at x where need u ≤ x (goes); after w x keeps, in order, the units that go on (GrammarLaws.keep); taken w is the sum of the uses; left giving w x is RegimeMargin.step giving (taken w) x. (`Becoming.WayOfUnits.need`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.use`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.goes`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.after`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.taken`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.left`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Goes s: some unit of s.1 has its need met at s.2. net giving is Law.stepWhile Goes on TurningInTime.pair after (left giving): the pair's step while some unit goes on, and nothing where none does; course is the pair's orbit. (`Becoming.WayOfUnits.Goes`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.net`, `Becoming.WayOfUnits.course`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.

(`Becoming.WayOfUnits.ends_while_net_goes`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps; a unit is a pair of whole numbers, its need and its use; a way is a list of units, repeats kept and counted; whole-number levels; one giving, a function of what is left after the take, the same for every way.
- The level's step is RegimeMargin.step giving (taken w): what every unit present at the step takes, summed, is taken first and as much as there is, and giving is added from what is left. A unit goes on where the level meets its need; a unit that ends takes nothing after.
- For unending_iff_holds: every unit of the start needing something; nothing given from nothing; the start at most hi; and Regime (Short, Meets and Keeps at what the way takes, with y of it, up to hi) at every way the course reaches with some unit going on there and at every step before it, the start's included. Not at every sub-way of the start, and not at the way where the net stops.
- For two_units_iff: n ≤ m; nothing given from nothing; Short, Meets and Keeps at H₂ with y₂ up to hi; 0 < n ≤ H₂ + y₂; Short at h + H₂ with y₁; the start below h + H₂ + y₁ and at most hi. A start at or above h + H₂ + y₁ is outside it.
- For greater_need: n ≤ m, m ≤ m', nothing given from nothing, Short, Meets and Keeps at H₂ with y₂ up to hi, the start at most hi. For more_use_on_first: n ≤ m, nothing given from nothing, the same sum h + H₂ = h' + H₂' with h ≤ h', Short, Meets and Keeps at H₂' with y₂' up to hi, the start at most hi. For unending_above: n ≤ m, nothing given from nothing, Short at H with y, 0 < n.
- takes_nothing_iff_alone asks only n ≤ m, under any giving and from any start; takes_nothing_ends adds nothing given from nothing, 0 < n, giving short of H₂ below y₁ and the start below H₂ + y₁. ends_while_net_goes asks one unit of the way whose need is above the level and one whose need it meets, under any giving.
- The needs, the uses, y, y₁, y₂ and hi are parameters; Short, Meets, Keeps and FromNothing are premises on the giving, as in TurningInTime. The two-unit theorems go through a carrier of two values and a transfer that needs n ≤ m.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Units only end. Nothing builds a unit, and nothing derives that a unit which needs more is there.
- The marks of a way that conditions on a reading (TurningInTime's marks, the lock's window, the gauges of reading in time) are not derived.
- The comparison theorems are for two units; none is stated for any number of units. That nothing given from nothing is needed is proved (GivenFromNothing); for each other premise they keep, only computed cases, not Lean, show it needed.
- Nothing about a trained system.
- **Counterexample:** Against reading the needs and the sum taken as enough: With and Against have the same needs, nine and one, the same sum taken, five, and the same levels up to the first unit's ending and one step after, nine, eight and six; with the first unit taking four the line never ends (With.goes_on), with it taking one it ends (Against.turns_and_ends). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WayOfUnits.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Found by simulation, not in Lean, on the design's form of unending_iff_holds: without the way being not empty, the empty way from three ends at once while, with nothing taken, the rest of the condition holds at once; without the start at most hi, under min z (12 − z) with hi 12, the unit (1, 10) from thirteen runs 13, 6, 0 and the line ends while the start is at or above 10 + 3. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/wu-a-way-of-units/readers/r3-logic.md)
- **Counterexample:** Found by simulation, not in Lean, on the module's first form: each premise of unending_iff_holds dropped alone, the others kept, has a case where the exact condition fails; without every unit needing something, a unit needing nothing goes on at level 0 for ever while no configuration holds; without the step keeping the level within hi, the levels 7, 9, 10, 4, 0 end the line though the course comes to a configuration that holds. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/wu-a-way-of-units/readers/v2-premises.md)
- **Counterexample:** Found by simulation, not in Lean: each premise of two_units_iff dropped alone has a case where the exact condition fails; without the step under H₂ keeping the level within hi, the levels 10, 9, 10, 11, 5 end the line while the condition on the course as it was holds; without n ≤ m, a first unit needing nothing keeps the line going while the condition, which asks a level below m, cannot hold. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/wu-a-way-of-units/readers/v2-premises.md)
- **Counterexample:** Found by simulation, not in Lean: each premise greater_need and more_use_on_first keep has a computed case in which the comparison fails without it (for nothing given from nothing the case is also a Lean witness, GivenFromNothing). Without the start at most hi: under giving 0, 4, 3, 0, 4, 4, 0 with hi five, units needing eight and one and taking one and three stay at eight from eight, while with the first needing nine the levels run eight, eight, nine, six, three, nothing. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/wu-a-way-of-units/readers/t1-trim.md)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, axiom reports empty (85 declarations, 64 theorems); a leaf, in the Lean's second layer only through its one import, TurningInTime. Compositions of landed theorems (RegimeMargin's point of no return and holding, turns_in_time_iff, the cut step's line) with an induction on the way's length; the witnesses computed. AI-written; a first design that claimed the marks derived was cut back, and the design, the Lean and the landing were each read by other AI agents set to refute them. Their simulations are not in Lean. No person's review of it is recorded yet.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (AI-written, from the home section's reading and the module's header): where a way is units that each take, the first of turning in time's three levels, where the level's fall first makes a difference to the way, is the need of a unit, and no mark is given; units end, one or several at a step, until what remains holds on what is left or until none goes on. An ending that takes nothing with it changes nothing in the level's course and can only be read: that the gauges near and mid of ReadOffInTime's witness of one loss, which need more and take nothing, are this case is a reading, their model being another. That ReadingsSpread's overdrawn focal line, which takes from its source while the source lasts and is removed once the source stands below its need while the wide line persists, is such a unit is a reading too. Nothing here is about keeping a unit from ending by lowering its need. No near work was read for this item beyond turning-in-time's.
